known.via: English Wikipedia "Coteaux du Layon AOC" (redirects to "Coteaux du Layon")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Pinot Gris, Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Franc is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.
Cabernet Sauvignon is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.

soil.rock: Schist, slate and gneiss break into stony, free-draining soil that holds the day's heat. Schist is rich in magnesium and potassium but poor in organic matter and nitrogen. Volcanic rock is porous, so it drains well and sends roots deep. Lava soils are mostly basalt, rich in iron, calcium and magnesium.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.
